COMBOS (bundles) for the Valeo Catalogue.recommendation: A combo is neither listing-level nor variant-level assembly: it is a LISTING that carries `combo?: ComboConfig`, exactly as Diagnostics and Treatments carry theirs, whose components are `PricedUnitRef { listingId, kind, unitId }` pointing at the row that actually holds money — a variant, a service option, or a plan. Referencing whole listings is impossible (a listing has no price) and variant-level is impossible (a variant cannot address another listing's plan), while making the combo a separate top-level entity would forfeit the URL, the four states, `countryConfig`, tag-based flash-sale scope, SEO locales, price floors and the audit trail that the Listing spine already provides for free. Only `priceMode: "fixed"` stores an amount, in a `ComboPrice` row shaped identically to `DiagnosticsServicePrice`/`TreatmentPlanPrice`; sum-of-parts, percent-off-sum and fixed-off-sum are derived every read, and the compare-at "you save X" figure is always derived so it cannot go stale. Two changes are non-negotiable prerequisites: a new `unitPrice()` resolver in `src/lib/pricing.ts` (the function that does not exist for any department today, and which also fixes the hardcoded `variants[0]`/UAE flash-sale call site), and replacing the ungated `variant` activation requirement with a department-dispatching `pricedUnit` one — without the latter a combo can never reach Published, the same trap already breaking seeded `l-blood` and `l-iv`.
risks: NAMING COLLISION: `combo` already means 'variant-axis combination' throughout src/lib/catalogue.ts (comboKey, comboLabel, comboMatrix, comboMatrix, missingCombos, duplicateComboVariantIds) and in the activation keys `comboUnique`/`comboComplete`. Mitigation: do NOT rename any of those (the keys and call sites depend on them); put all combo-entity resolvers in a new src/lib/combos.ts with a header comment stating the disambiguation. Residual risk: a future reader greps `combo` and conflates the two.

The activation-gate change touches a function every one of the ~1,559 seeded listings passes through. `hasPricedUnit` must be behaviour-identical to `hasPricedVariant` for `products_devices` or 321 migrated product listings change publishability in one commit. The 35 `sd-tx-injection` treatments listings are the live hazard: they currently PASS on `regionalData[].price` (money the editor hides for tx) and would start FAILING under a treatments-aware `hasPricedUnit`, because none carries a `treatments` config. Needs a deliberate migration decision, not a silent flip.

Derived pricing means the customer-facing price of a live combo changes with no audit entry on the combo. The audit lands correctly on the part (decision 10 satisfied at the entity that changed), but 'who changed this combo's price' has no single answer — a support/finance question the audit UI cannot answer from one entity's history. Needs a cross-entity 'affected combos' view, which does not exist.

Both existing Pattern A city resolvers (`servicePrice`, `planPrice`) carry a live inherit bug: their bare `{ ...base, ...city }` copies own `undefined` properties, so a city price that was typed and then cleared overwrites the country price with undefined and both `finalServicePrice` and `finalPlanPrice` return undefined at their `p.price === undefined` guard. A combo in sum-of-parts mode inherits that bug and silently prices as 'no price'. `comboPrice` must use effectiveSlot's inherit-not-zero merge, and the two existing resolvers should be fixed in the same change.

`FlashSale.timezone` is inert — `saleState` compares absolute instants while the editor writes `new Date(input).toISOString()` from a `datetime-local`, i.e. the operator's browser zone. Combos inherit this: a combo suppressed by `comboIsWorseThanParts` flips on the wrong wall clock in KSA vs UAE. Not caused by combos, but combos make it customer-visible on a price rather than only on a badge.

`PartnerPrice` has three optional scoping axes (variant × country × city) and no resolver at all. A combo containing a partner-priced component computes its sum from PUBLIC list prices and can undercut a signed contract. Mitigated by forcing `fixed` mode plus a combo-level PartnerAccessEntry and raising an advisory gap, but this is a mitigation not a fix — the real fix is a partner price resolver, which is out of scope here.

`Order` is a thin mock (`items: Array<{name; type}>`) with no line items, no fulfilment jobs and no split concept. The CMS can only DECLARE the split shape (`comboFulfilmentPaths` + `dependsOnComponentId` + `gating`); nothing validates that the order service can honour it. The allocation and gating contract must be agreed with the Order and Finance services before a combo is sold, or the CMS is describing a split nobody implements.

Component count multiplies the editable surface: each component needs a country × city price read, an availability check and possibly an explicit allocation share per country. 5 components × 5 countries × 7 cities is already 175 resolutions per PDP render. `MAX_VARIANT_COMBOS = 100` exists as the analogous human-editability ceiling; combos need one too (recommend max 8 components) or the editor stops being usable and the resolvers stop being cheap.

A combo PDP competing with its components' PDPs for the same search intent is a real SEO risk (thin/duplicate content, cannibalised rankings). Mitigated by requiring own copy, own hero, self-canonical and no copied component body text — but `SeoLocaleEntry`'s three-level city→country→master fallback still has NO resolver anywhere (it exists only as placeholder strings in SeoLocalisation.tsx), so a combo's per-country SEO inheritance is undefined behaviour like everything else's.

Freebies across listings — mechanism, mo.topic: Freebies across listings — mechanism, model, and resolved behaviour for every case
Freebies across listings — mechanism, mo.recommendation: Split freebies by permanence, not by department. If the gift survives after every campaign ends it is a bill-of-materials component of the priced unit — a new `IncludedItem[]` on `ProductVariant`, `TreatmentPlan` and `DiagnosticsServiceOption`, i.e. exactly where price already lives (decision 3). If it has a window it is a campaign, and it becomes a `Freebie` entity that is a sibling of `FlashSale`, never written onto the listing. In both cases the gift is a typed reference `{ listingId, unitKind, unitId?, quantity }` to a real listing at its real price — never a hand-typed string (kills `TreatmentPlan.giftEn`), never a duplicate listing (`pkg-blood-417` "GLP-1 Baseline Blood Test (Free with Wegovy)" vs the canonical `pkg-blood-398`), and never a zero-priced part, because a second price of 0 for a real product leaks into `catalog_pricing`, category price filters and search. This work is blocked on one function that does not exist anywhere in the repo: `pricedUnits(listing, country, cityId?)`, which flash sales also need (`flash-sales/page.tsx:405-407` hardcodes `variants[0]` and `"UAE"`).

cases.case: "Mounjaro 7.5mg + Doctor Consultation + Free Needles" — you physically cannot inject without needles
cases.behaviour: Permanent IncludedItem on the Mounjaro variant: { listingId: needles, unitKind: "variant", quantity: 4, isClinicallyRequired: true }. The five pkg-custom-704/706/707/708/709 listings are ARCHIVED (nothing deletes, decision 4) and their traffic redirects to the canonical Mounjaro listing. No Freebie entity, no window — a BOM has no end date.

cases.case: "Free Marine Collagen supplement" bundled with an IV single session
cases.behaviour: IncludedItem on the TreatmentPlan (kind "single"), pointing at the real Health Products collagen listing + variant, quantity 1. TreatmentPlan.giftEn is deprecated and the plan-card string is derived via giftLabel(). The collagen now decrements stock and appears in giveaway reporting; as a string it did neither.

cases.case: "Free after consultation" on a course plan (TreatmentPlan.kind === "course")
cases.behaviour: IncludedItem on that plan pointing at the consultation listing, isClinicallyRequired true. TreatmentPlan.includesConsultation stops being a stored boolean and becomes derived from includes[] — one source of truth, and the operator now says WHICH consultation, which the boolean could never express.

cases.case: "GLP-1 Baseline Blood Test (Free with Wegovy)" — pkg-blood-417, a duplicate of a real panel whose only difference is a promotion
cases.behaviour: Freebie: scopeKind "tag", tagId = a campaign-namespace tag on the Wegovy listings, triggerUnit "variant", gift = { listingId: pkg-blood-398 (the canonical Metabolic/GLP-1 panel), unitKind: "service_option", unitId: so-standard, quantity: 1 }. pkg-blood-417 and pkg-blood-387 are archived. This is the single strongest argument in the data: the promotion had been forked into the catalogue as product rows.

cases.case: "Mounjaro 2.5mg + At-home GLP1 Baseline Blood Test + Free consultation" — pkg-custom-714, a MEDICINE filed under department "diagnostics"
cases.behaviour: Proof that combo-as-a-listing corrupts the WHAT-IT-IS taxonomy (decision 2): the department was name-parsed off a promotional title and landed in the wrong department. Resolution: one Mounjaro listing (products_devices), the blood test as a Freebie gift, the consult as an IncludedItem. pkg-custom-714 archived. Combos are NEVER new listings.

cases.case: "Free Testosterone Test - Ballers" — pkg-blood-132, a partner-specific giveaway encoded in a display name
cases.behaviour: Freebie with partnerIds: [ballers-partner-id], resolved against the parent listing's PartnerAccessEntry. The parent listing's visibility does not change and it stays in Valeo master search; only the gift line is withheld from non-partner buyers. Listing.partnerExclusive stays a listing-level concept and is untouched. pkg-blood-132 archived in favour of the canonical pkg-blood-133.

cases.case: "Wegovy 0.25, 0.5 and 1 Program (1 Free)" — quantity trigger where the gift is the parent itself
cases.behaviour: Freebie with condition { kind: "min_quantity", minQuantity: 3 } and gift.listingId === the scoped listing id. Self-reference is explicitly legal in GiftRef and freebieGaps must not flag it. The 4th unit is granted at zero on the order line; the variant's own price never becomes 0.

cases.case: 96 free doctor consultations in the coach data (14 visible in DHC_LISTINGS display names, e.g. "Free Peptide Consultation", "Free IV Therapy Consultation", "Dr Sidra : Free Consultation")
cases.behaviour: Do NOT create 96 free consultation listings. One consultation listing per practitioner/service (they already exist), renamed to drop "Free". "Free" moves into either an IncludedItem on the buying listing's priced unit or a Freebie. The word "free" never appears in displayNameEn — that is the legacy hack in its purest form.

cases.case: Genuinely free standalone products: pkg-custom-57 "Free Coach Consultation", pkg-custom-239 "Physio Session - Free"
cases.behaviour: NOT freebies at all — priced units with price 0, bought on their own. They currently cannot be Published: listingActivationRequirements demands (r.price ?? 0) > 0. Fix the gate to accept >= 0 when Listing.isFreeOffering === true. This is a defect the freebie work surfaces, not a freebie feature.

cases.case: Combo of two PAID parts: the 13 "+ Doctor Consultation" rows (pkg-custom-781..788, 734..736)
cases.behaviour: Neither a freebie nor a listing. If the consult is the mandatory Rx gate → IncludedItem, zero-charged, with the consult's list price recorded as giveawayValue. If it is optional and paid → consultationAddonEnabled + consultationAddonPrice, or frequentlyBought. Which of the two each row is, is a data-migration decision per row, made by the category manager, not derivable from the name.

cases.case: "Free needles" only in countries where the pen actually ships
cases.behaviour: IncludedItem.countries = ["UAE","KSA"]. On top of that, resolveGift returns not_sold_in_country whenever the GIFT listing has no CatalogCountryConfig row for that country (pattern B: no row = not available), so an operator cannot promise a gift into a market it is not sold in even by listing the country. freebieGaps reports the mismatch before publish.

cases.case: Gift that is city-bound (a home nursing visit gifted only in Dubai)
cases.behaviour: Freebie only — FreebieRule.cityIds. IncludedItem is deliberately country-scoped with no cityId: a BOM that varies by city is a different sellable unit, and adding a third city-override pattern would import the own-property-undefined inheritance bug that already exists in TreatmentPlans.tsx:66 and DiagnosticsSlots.tsx:64 (a cleared city field overwrites the country value with undefined instead of inheriting).

cases.case: Campaign gift goes out of stock (variant isAvailable false, warehouseStock 0, or VariantStatus inactive)
cases.behaviour: Derived every request by resolveGift — never stored. Default oosPolicy "hide_gift": the parent stays fully buyable and the gift line disappears from the PDP, because a promise you cannot keep is worse than no promise. "substitute" swaps in substituteGift (and if the substitute is also unavailable, falls through to hide_gift). "block_parent" is rejected by freebieGaps for a Freebie — a campaign must never be able to take a live product off sale.

cases.case: Permanent include goes out of stock (no needles in the warehouse)
cases.behaviour: The parent priced unit becomes unbuyable: pricedUnits() returns isAvailable false with unavailableReason "include_oos", and only when isClinicallyRequired === true. This is the ONE place a gift blocks a sale, and it is an IncludedItem property, never a Freebie one. When isClinicallyRequired is false (a nice-to-have bundled sachet), the include is silently omitted and the parent sells on.

cases.case: Gift listing is archived or still draft
cases.behaviour: freebieGaps hard-blocks going live ("Gift listing is not Published"). If a LIVE freebie's gift is later archived, resolveGift fails closed — no gift is granted and the freebie surfaces in an ops alert list on /catalogue/flash-sales' sibling freebies page. An archived product can never ship as a gift, which the duplicate-listing approach could not guarantee.

cases.case: Gift has no priced unit of the declared kind (fs-weekend's exact bug: pricedUnit "service_option" pointed at listings with variants: [])
cases.behaviour: freebieGaps closes flash-sale gap #9 for both entities: it asserts the gift listing returns at least one PricedUnit of gift.unitKind in every country in rules[], and that the SCOPED listings return at least one unit of triggerUnit. Today flash-sales renders the literal string "no UAE price to show" and ships anyway.

cases.case: Freebie on a Doctors & Health Coaches or Home & Personal Care listing
cases.behaviour: pricedUnits() returns [] — 0 of 135 DHC_LISTINGS and 0 of 106 home_personal listings carry any priced unit, and no department-specific price structure exists for either. freebieGaps blocks with "this department has no priced unit yet". Same blocking gap flash sales already have; freebies do not fix it and must not pretend to.

cases.case: Diagnostics gift where Standard and Fast Track differ
cases.behaviour: IncludedItem attaches to DiagnosticsServiceOption.includes, not to DiagnosticsConfig and never to DiagnosticsSlotMapping — identical rule to price ("Pricing lives here, not on the slot rows"). Fast Track can include a coach call that Standard does not.

cases.case: Parent listing is in a live flash sale AND a freebie applies
cases.behaviour: Freebie.stacksWithFlashSale, default true — a gift is not a price operation, so it neither stacks with nor competes against a discount; it is granted or it is not. Set false to suppress the gift while any live sale prices the parent (the "don't give away margin twice" case). Resolution order is fixed and stated: (1) base price from pricedUnits, (2) the row's own discountType/discountValue via finalServicePrice/finalPlanPrice, (3) flash sale via effectivePrice, (4) grant freebies. Order only matters for min_spend, which is evaluated on the POST-discount total — the customer must actually spend the threshold.

cases.case: Coupon on top of a freebie
cases.behaviour: Freebie.stacksWithCoupons mirrors FlashSale.stacksWithCoupons and is honoured by the read path when coupons exist. Today there is NO coupon entity — PromoBanner.couponCode is a free string — so the flag is inert and the editor must LABEL it inert ("no coupon engine yet") rather than imply it works. FlashSale.stacksWithCoupons is already stored, edited, seeded, audited and read by nothing; do not add a second silently-dead flag.

cases.case: Two freebies both apply to the same cart
cases.behaviour: Both grant. Gifts accumulate — unlike prices, where effectivePrice picks the single best. There is no cost model, so "best gift wins" is not computable and any ranking would be arbitrary. Each freebie is capped by its own FreebieRule.maxPerOrder (default 1). Display order is deterministic: startsAt, then id.

cases.case: Two freebies grant the SAME gift unit
cases.behaviour: Deduped by (listingId, unitId): granted once at quantity = max(quantities), with BOTH freebies recorded as attributions on the grant so ops can see which campaign to charge. Without dedupe the customer is shipped two collagens for one purchase.

cases.case: Parent is discountable: false (GLP-1, MOH-regulated, partner-contracted)
cases.behaviour: A permanent IncludedItem is ALLOWED — needles are part of the therapy, not a discount. A campaign Freebie is BLOCKED by freebieGaps by default, releasable only via Freebie.overridesDiscountable with a mandatory overrideNote that lands in the audit entry. Whether a free item constitutes a regulated inducement under UAE MOH / KSA SFDA advertising rules is a COMPLIANCE DECISION A HUMAN MUST MAKE — the CMS's job is to make the override explicit, attributable and reversible, not to encode the answer.

cases.case: The gift itself is a prescription-required medicine (ListingAttributes.isRxRequired, or medicineType a controlled MedicineClass)
cases.behaviour: Hard block in freebieGaps and in resolveGift (reason "rx_blocked"), with NO override. An item that requires a prescription can never be auto-granted by a marketing campaign. Note this is the only exclusion axis beyond discountable that exists in the model today — flash sales check neither.

cases.case: A gifted consultation consumes a practitioner slot
cases.behaviour: NOT RESOLVABLE IN THIS MODEL, and no field should be invented. Practitioner has no availability, capacity or calendar fields; SlotGroup and DiagnosticsSlotMapping are nurse-and-diagnostics scoped. What the CMS ships: resolveGift exposes requiresBooking (derived — gift listing's fulfilmentPath is "consultation" or "home_service") so ops can see which freebies create human work, and freebieGaps warns when a booking-creating gift listing has no practitionerIds mapped. Actual capacity is consumed by the Order Service at booking time. Escalated as an open question.

cases.case: How the freebie appears on the PDP
cases.behaviour: Two derived blocks, no new copy fields. IncludedItem renders unconditionally as "What's included" (it is part of what you bought). A live Freebie renders as a windowed line with the resolved gift name and end time. Both strings come from giftLabel(), which defaults to the gift listing's displayNameEn and is overridable only via IncludedItem.labelEn/labelAr. "Free" never enters displayNameEn, seoTitleEn or a slug.

cases.case: The freebie must not be separately purchasable at zero
cases.behaviour: Structurally impossible in this design: the gift is a normal listing at its normal price, and the zero exists only on the granted order line. Nothing in the catalogue ever carries a 0 price for a gift. This is precisely why a freebie is NOT "a combo with a zero-priced part" — a zero-priced part is a second, wrong price for a real product and would leak into catalog_pricing, into "Under 99 AED"-style price filters, and into search.

cases.case: Subscription purchase + freebie
cases.behaviour: condition.kind "subscription_only". Granted on the FIRST cycle only by default; grantEveryCycle: true grants on every renewal. Necessary because RegionalData.subscriptionPriceWeekly/Monthly/Quarterly/BiAnnual are recurring charges, so "one gift per purchase" is ambiguous without saying which.

cases.case: first_purchase condition
cases.behaviour: Declared on FreebieCondition, evaluated by the read path / Order Service — the CMS has no customer model at all. Same honest status as stacksWithCoupons: the editor stores it and labels it as evaluated downstream. It is not silently ignored.

cases.case: Freebie scoped by tag, where the operator picks the wrong namespace
cases.behaviour: freebieGaps rejects any scope tag whose namespace is not "campaign" (decision 7 — goal/audience/condition are meaning, ops/clinical are internal and must never reach a storefront surface). Add the same check to flashSaleGaps, which does not have it today.

cases.case: Freebie window crosses midnight in KSA while the operator is in Dubai
cases.behaviour: Both freebieState and saleState route through the new windowState(isDraft, startsAt, endsAt, timezone, now), which interprets the stored wall-clock against the declared timezone. Today FlashSale.timezone is inert and the datetime-local input is read in the operator's browser zone — freebies must not inherit that. Grant is decided at ORDER PLACEMENT, not at cart-add, so a cart that sat open past the end does not get the gift.

cases.case: Margin / cost reporting must see the giveaway
cases.behaviour: giveawayValue(gift, listings, country) returns the gift unit's LIST price in that country — pre-flash-sale, pre-coupon — because the sale is not being redeemed. This is a VALUE, not a cost: no COGS field exists anywhere in the model (RegionalData has price, vat, warehouseStock — no cost). Flagged as a risk; a real margin number needs a cost field that does not exist.

cases.case: How ops sees how many freebies have been given away
cases.behaviour: Derived from orders — never a counter on the Freebie entity. And it is not buildable today: Order is minimal (total, items: { name, type }[]) with no module-level store, no line items, no listingId, no grant record. What the CMS ships now: the freebies list page with resolved scope count, live gift stock at a glance, and a full audit trail (AuditEntityType "freebie"). The order side needs a campaign_freebie_grant row per granted line. Note Qatar creates no invoices at all, so giveaway cost can never be reconstructed from Zoho for Qatar — reporting must read orders, not books.

cases.case: The freebie campaign needs a landing page
cases.behaviour: landingCategoryId links an EXISTING category page, exactly as FlashSale does. A giveaway must never become a Category or Sub-category node — that is how "50% OFF" and "Under 99 AED" became permanent categories in the legacy catalogue (decision 2).

cases.case: Retiring a freebie
cases.behaviour: Nothing deletes (decision 4). A Freebie ends by its window or by isDraft; the entity persists for reporting. An IncludedItem is retired with isActive: false, not removed, so audit diffs and past orders still resolve the reference.

cases.case: Auditing
cases.behaviour: Freebie create/update/status writes AuditEntityType "freebie" with before/after via the existing diffEntities + auditStore path. IncludedItem changes audit under entityType "listing" (they live on the listing) and need LISTING_LABELS entries so a diff reads "What's included → Marine Collagen ×1 (UAE)" rather than a raw JSON blob.

cases.case: Legacy TreatmentPlan.giftEn values already in the data
cases.behaviour: Kept read-only for one release and rendered with a "convert to an included item" action that resolves the string against listings by name and asks the operator to confirm the match. Auto-matching a free-text string to a listing id without confirmation is how the wrong product ships.

risks: pricedUnits() is a hard dependency, not a nice-to-have: freebies, flash sales, combos and any margin view all need it, and it does not exist. If it is not built first, freebies will be validated against variants[0] in UAE like flash sales are.

No COGS field exists anywhere (RegionalData carries price, vat, warehouseStock — no cost). giveawayValue is a list-price proxy, so any margin report built on it overstates cost for high-markup items and understates it for low.

No order line-item model and no ORDERS_STORE: Order has total and items: { name, type }[]. Redemption counting, per-campaign giveaway totals and 'did the gift actually ship' are all unbuildable until the order side gains a grant record. Qatar compounds this — it creates no invoices at all, so Zoho can never be the source.
Practitioner has no capacity model, so gifted consultations can be promised without limit. A campaign that gives away 500 free consults is indistinguishable in the CMS from one that gives away 5.

Two more inert flags: stacksWithCoupons (no coupon entity — PromoBanner.couponCode is a free string) and condition.kind first_purchase (no customer model). FlashSale.pricedUnit and FlashSale.stacksWithCoupons are already stored, edited, seeded, audited and read by nothing; adding two more dead fields without labelling them inert repeats that.
IncludedItem introduces a cycle risk: listing A includes B, B includes A. resolveGift must cap traversal depth at 1 (a gift may not itself carry includes that are granted) or the PDP recurses.

Archiving the 20+ legacy 'Free …' and '+ …' listings breaks live URLs and paid-ad destinations. Archived means the URL stops resolving (decision 4), so every archived row needs a redirect to its canonical listing before, not after.

The city-override inheritance bug (own-property undefined overwriting the country value, TreatmentPlans.tsx:66 / DiagnosticsSlots.tsx:64) will reproduce in any per-city freebie editor unless the effectiveSlot()-style key-restoring merge is used instead of a bare spread.

Freebie and FlashSale being near-identical shapes invites divergence over time. If windowState, scope resolution and the campaign-tag namespace check are not shared functions from day one, the two will drift the way 'percent' and 'percentage' already have.
openQuestions: Does a free item attached to a discountable: false GLP-1 listing count as a regulated inducement under UAE MOH / KSA SFDA advertising rules — yes or no? (Decides whether overridesDiscountable ships at all.)
Should campaign Freebies be forbidden outright on Rx-required parent listings, leaving only permanent clinical IncludedItems — yes or no?
Does capacity for gifted consultations belong to the Order Service rather than the CMS — yes or no? (If no, Practitioner needs an availability model and that is a separate design.)
Does a gifted physical product ship on the same order line and waybill as the parent, or as a separate fulfilment — same, yes or no?
Which single value is the giveaway reported at: gift list price, gift post-sale effective price, or a new RegionalData.cost field?
Is TreatmentPlan.giftEn safe to remove in this release, or must it stay read-only for one release with a convert action — remove now, yes or no?
When a permanent include is out of stock, does the parent block in every department, or only where isClinicallyRequired is true — only where required, yes or no?
What is the global maximum number of gifts per order, across all freebies — one number?
Do partner-gated freebies (the Ballers case) show on the public PDP as 'available to Ballers members', or not render at all for non-partners — show, yes or no?
Should Listing.isFreeOffering exist as an explicit flag, or should a price of 0 alone be sufficient to publish — flag, yes or no?
Is min_spend evaluated on the post-discount line total (recommended) rather than the pre-discount total — post-discount, yes or no?
Do freebies get their own page at /catalogue/freebies, or a second tab on the existing flash-sales page — own page, yes or no?
